Quick bit of gossip for you. I was chatting with a contact at a trade show and they mentioned, totally second-hand, that Hollis is talking to Routewise. I can't confirm this, so please take it with a big grain of salt. It's just hearsay and I didn't want to sit on it.

If I hear anything firmer I'll let you know. Might be worth keeping an ear out on your end too.

Kyle
